avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May overstimulate immune system concurrently with pegfilgrastim, potentially causing excessive immune activation and unpredictable WBC responses
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if patient desires immune support, defer until pegfilgrastim course completed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose vitamin C (>2000 mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance myeloid progenitor proliferation unpredictably and interfere with intended G-CSF dosing titration
avoid_supplements.action: Limit supplemental vitamin C to <1000 mg daily; monitor CBC responses

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May interact with neutropenia-related infection risk; benefits unclear during pegfilgrastim therapy but generally considered low-risk
caution_supplements.action: Acceptable to continue; counsel on hand hygiene and monitoring for infection signs

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild anti-inflammatory effects that could theoretically modulate response to G-CSF; minimal clinical impact documented
caution_supplements.action: May continue; no dose adjustment needed

avoid_foods.name: Undercooked or raw meats/seafood
avoid_foods.mechanism: Pegfilgrastim-induced neutropenia significantly increases infection risk from foodborne pathogens; immunocompromised patients at severe risk for invasive infections
avoid_foods.action: Enforce strict food safety; use only well-cooked proteins; avoid sushi, undercooked eggs, unpasteurized dairy

avoid_foods.name: Unwashed fresh produce
avoid_foods.mechanism: Environmental bacteria and mold contamination pose significant infection risk in neutropenic patients
avoid_foods.action: Thoroughly wash all raw fruits/vegetables; consider limiting fresh produce during severe neutropenia phases

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May contribute to fluid retention and potential exacerbation of bone pain (common pegfilgrastim side effect); no direct pharmacokinetic interaction
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderate sodium intake; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for musculoskeletal symptoms

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Pegfilgrastim undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism, but grapefruit may have minor immunomodulatory effects; clinical significance low
caution_foods.action: No strict prohibition, but recommend limiting; preference for other citrus fruits

monitoring_notes: Monitor CBC parameters closely during pegfilgrastim therapy, particularly WBC trends and platelet counts, as supplements/foods affecting immune or hematopoietic function may alter therapeutic response. Emphasize strict food safety protocols given neutropenia risk, and counsel patients on infection prevention, including hand hygiene and symptom reporting (fever >100.4°F, chills, oral ulcers).
